modal.title: Kitsiso
modal.text: Baeng ba ba rategang! Letlalo lengwe le lengwe mo polokelong eno ke maduo a diura tse dintsi tsa tiro e e boima. Tsweetswee tlotlang tiro ya ba bangwe. Ditshwantsho tsotlhe di sireleditswe ka ditshwanelo tsa mokwadi. Go leba go letleletswe, mme go kopolola, go gatisa le go dirisa mo kgwebong go letleletswe fela ka tumalano ya pele. Re lebogela tlhaloganyo le boikanyegi jwa lona!
